SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,  -- Assuming you have a customer_name column
    SUM(o.quantity * o.price) AS total_order_value
FROM
    Customers c
JOIN
    Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
    c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY
    total_order_value DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
